_about: The profile exe patch 162 (v011w_render) reads to draw a 0.11 weather the 0.11 way: srp_renderer_v011w at the root of each of its client projects, a table of 0.11e's post-process material values of that weather (material_instances/post_process/level_03_evn and level_03_rain: atmosphere_inscatter_distance). On those scenes the patch draws 0.11e's fog, scattering tables and sky. The table may also name 0.11e's filmic curve (shoulder_strength, linear_strength, linear_angle, toe_strength, toe_numerator, toe_denominator, linear_white, dark_desaturation_limit: evening .05, 7, .3, 6.2, 2, .02, 10000, 4.5; rain .01, 6.2, .3, 6.2, 2, .02, 8, 6) for 0.11e's post; these do not yet: the post twin draws without its frame (docs/notes/v011-weather.md). Another map takes a 0.11 weather by giving its projects such a table. No other project has the key.
